meta.name: baoyu-danger-x-to-markdown
meta.description: Converts X (Twitter) tweets and articles to markdown with YAML front matter. Uses reverse-engineered API requiring user consent. Use when user mentions "X to markdown", "tweet to markdown", "save tweet", or provides x.com/twitter.com URLs for conversion.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把X推文和文章转成带元数据的Markdown
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要保存X平台的内容到本地做笔记或备份。
copy.tagline_en: Convert X tweets and articles to Markdown with YAML front matter
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to save X content locally for notes or backup.

howto.what: 给它 x.com 或 twitter.com 的推文、线程或文章链接,它会把内容转成带 YAML front matter 的 markdown 文件存到本地,可选把图片、视频下载到本地目录。首次使用需先同意免责声明并完成偏好设置。
howto.when: 当你提到 “X to markdown”、“save tweet” 等关键词,或直接给出 x.com / twitter.com 的推文、文章链接时触发。

say.text: 这条推文的图片和视频也一起下载到本地
这条推文改用 JSON 输出
say.note: 返回 JSON 而不是 markdown 文件

howto.what_en: Point it at an x.com or twitter.com tweet or article link; it converts the content into a markdown file with YAML front matter, optionally downloading images and videos locally. First use needs a disclaimer accepted and preferences set.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "X to markdown" or "save tweet", or give an x.com / twitter.com tweet or article URL.

say_en.text: Turn this link into markdown: https://x.com/user/status/123
say_en.note: Checks consent and preferences first, then writes the .md file

say_en.text: Download this tweet's images and videos too
say_en.note: Adds --download-media, saving files into imgs/ and videos/

say_en.text: Output that tweet as JSON instead
say_en.note: Returns JSON output rather than a markdown file
